question: Does the matched-depth advantage repeat with unchanged weights on all 56 untouched confirmation stories?
protocol: Use identically ordered tokenized user turns, native unrestricted greedy first-turn decoding, identical generation limits, common-prefix animal probes and end-to-end timings. The two variants use the same pretrained decoder and native layers 10..15 for recurrent evidence. An equal-training fit repeats the original seed, parameters, optimizer, steps, all training targets including both support labels, and all 240 stories. No selection or fitting on test. All fixed-weight arms are bound by digest.
gate: At least eight net correct complete answers, exact paired two-sided p<0.05, >=4 net content probes and <=1.5 times control elapsed seconds. A failed prerequisite or comparison closes its downstream jobs. No retries with relaxed thresholds.
